title: Beyond Good and Evil
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
blurb: Nietzsche's sharpest book: our morals hide deeper drives, every deep thinker wears a mask, and the herd hates whoever stands apart.

abyss.m: A very deep hole; a frightening emptiness.
abyss.e: Staring into the abyss of debt kept him awake.

profound.e: Losing a pet can be a profound sadness.

militant.e: The militant fan argued with everyone online.

insanity.e: Driving at that speed in rain is insanity.

despises.m: Feels strong dislike and disrespect for.

despiser.m: Feels strong dislike and disrespect for.

cards.title: Fighting monsters
cards.text: Nietzsche's most quoted warning: whoever fights monsters must be careful not to become one. Stare too long into darkness and it gets into you.
cards.quote: He who fights with monsters should be careful lest he thereby become a monster.
cards.qMean: When you fight something evil, be careful not to become evil yourself.
cards.qLife: A team fighting online trolls by turning into trolls themselves.
cards.cap: Saint Michael Fighting the Dragon, from The Apocalypse · public domain

cards.title: The abyss looks back
cards.text: The second half of the line: gaze long into an abyss and the abyss gazes into you. What we obsess over changes us.
cards.quote: And if thou gaze long into an abyss, the abyss will also gaze into thee.
cards.qMean: If you dwell on darkness too long, it starts to change you.
cards.qLife: Reading crime news all night and then fearing every stranger.
cards.cap: Gustave Doré, Into the Abyss (Dante's Inferno) · public domain

cards.title: Every deep mind wears a mask
cards.text: Deep people grow masks, partly because others always misunderstand them. The mask is protection, not just deceit.
cards.quote: Every profound spirit needs a mask
cards.qMean: Deep thinkers hide behind a public face.
cards.qLife: A comedian who jokes all the time but is serious in private.
cards.cap: Venetian Jugglers in front of the Palace of the Doge (SM 1529) · public domain

cards.title: The madness of groups
cards.text: Madness is rare in single people but normal in groups, parties, nations and eras.
cards.quote: Insanity in individuals is something rare--but in groups, parties, nations, and epochs it is the rule.
cards.qMean: One person rarely goes mad, but groups often do.
cards.qLife: Sensible people joining a crazy online trend together.
cards.cap: Paul Addresses the Crowd After His Arrest by Gustave Doré · public domain

cards.title: Self-contempt is pride
cards.text: Even someone who despises himself still respects himself — as the one who judges.
cards.quote: He who despises himself, nevertheless esteems himself thereby, as a despiser.
cards.qMean: Even self-criticism hides a little self-respect.
cards.qLife: The person who says 'I'm the worst' is often waiting for you to disagree.
cards.cap: Albrecht Dürer - Melencolia I · public domain

cards.title: Fighters at peace
cards.text: In peaceful times, the fighting kind of person turns against himself.
cards.quote: Under peaceful conditions the militant man attacks himself.
cards.qMean: Fighters with no outside enemy start fighting themselves.
cards.qLife: An athlete forced to rest starts being hard on themselves.
